Electronic stability control, four-wheel independent suspension, and a comprehensive airbag system work together to provide security for all occupants. The power liftgate facilitates easy access to cargo areas, while the split-folding rear seat and reclining third-row seat adapt the interior space to your specific needs.

This 2023 Chrysler Pacifica Touring L offers the reliability and capability your family needs for everyday journeys and special occasions alike.

- 50 Point Safety Vehicle Inspection
- Uconnect 5 with 10.1" Touchscreen Display
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Integration
- ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera
- Heated Front Seats and Heated Steering Wheel
- Caprice Leatherette Bucket Seats
- Power Liftgate
- Front Dual Zone Automatic Temperature Control
- Rear Air Conditioning
- Four Wheel Independent Suspension
- Dual Front Impact and Side Impact Airbags
- Electronic Stability Control with Traction Control
- 3.6L V6 Engine with 9-Speed Automatic Transmission
- 17" Aluminum Alloy Wheels

Built for families who demand comfort without compromise, the Pacifica Touring L combines practical space with refined appointments. The bright white exterior presents a clean, well-maintained appearance that turns heads while remaining versatile for any setting. Inside, the leatherette bucket seats provide comfort for daily commutes and long road trips, while the heated seats and steering wheel add warmth during colder months.

The Uconnect 5 system keeps you connected with its expansive 10.1" touchscreen display, seamlessly integrating your smartphone through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. SiriusXM satellite radio ensures your favorite content accompanies you wherever the road leads. The integrated active noise cancellation technology reduces cabin disturbance, creating a more serene driving environment for all passengers.

Safety remains paramount in this minivan. The dual-zone front air conditioning and rear climate control ensure every occupant travels comfortably, while the comprehensive airbag system and electronic stability control provide protection. The ParkView rear back-up camera assists with parking and reversing, making tight spaces manageable. The four-wheel independent suspension and touring-tuned handling deliver composed driving dynamics.

Performance comes from a capable 3.6L V6 engine paired with a 9-Speed 948TE automatic transmission, achieving 19 city and 28 highway miles per gallon. The power liftgate, split-folding rear seats, and thoughtful interior storage make loading and organizing trips intuitive. Dual front zone climate control, rear air conditioning, and the power driver seat with memory function accommodate multiple preferences for an enjoyable trip every time.

With its combination of family-focused features, modern connectivity, and proven reliability, this Pacifica Touring L stands ready to serve your household for years to come. We invite you to visit our showroom and experience firsthand how this minivan can enhance your family's lifestyle.

That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.

Driving The Used 2023 Chrysler Pacifica Hybrid

Firstly, there s no real learning curve to dealing with a hybrid. You can drive it just like a regular vehicle. Put it in gear, check surroundings, and off we go, steering and braking when necessary.

It s easy enough in the Pacifica Hybrid. Outward vision is enhanced by a raised driving position, along with blind-spot monitoring. Maneuvering is aided by a 360-degree camera system, plus parking sensors at both ends with automatic braking.

A new feature in the 2023 Pacifica Hybrid is a Max Regeneration message that comes up in the instrument cluster whenever recovered braking energy or particular conditions result in optimum fuel efficiency.

Interior Comfort

This 2023 Pacifica Hybrid seats seven, with a pair of captain s chairs as standard in the second row. The third row can fold into the floor when more cargo space is required.

Occupant space and comfort are in plentiful supply, even in the third row. There are 10 cup holders, up to 12 USB ports, and now an N95 cabin filter that prevents 95 percent of particulates from entering the cabin, including bacteria, pollen, and other allergens.

A FamCam interior camera is offered, so grown-ups in the front seats can keep watch on the antics of those less mature passengers. Even the entry-level model still has a convex conversation mirror above the usual rearview mirror for a view into the back of Pacifica Hybrid.

This hybrid model doesn t compromise on cargo space compared with its non-hybrid stablemate. Behind the rearmost row is a luggage area of 32.3 cubic feet. Maximum cargo volume behind the front seats measures 140.5 cubic feet. That s pretty good, but if this aspect is particularly important.

Exterior Styling

We ve all seen hybrid cars looking different from regular cars, making whatever eco-friendly statement the driver wants to get across. The Chrysler Pacifica Hybrid doesn t do that.

Apart from some understated badges, the casual observer would assume this was just another minivan, not the fuel-efficient family transport marvel it really is. But people don t buy minivans for the looks, which are affected by the practical considerations of accommodating three rows of seating, plenty of headroom, and a generous luggage area. Where a minivan wins over an SUV is the low step-in height and sliding side doors, making it so easy to get in and out.

Favorite Features

HANDS-FREE SLIDING SIDE DOORS

Parents tend to need another pair of hands at most times, but especially when trying to get the herd into the car. Or, in this case, minivan. A wave of the foot opens the side doors or the tailgate. Touring L has these on the options list, and they re standard in the top two trims.

Standard Features

At its entry level, the 2023 Pacifica Hybrid comes with 17-inch alloy wheels, power-sliding side doors, powered tailgate, keyless entry/start, remote start, tri-zone automatic climate control, N95 cabin air filter, heated/leather-wrapped steering wheel, heated front seats, 8-way power-adjustable driver s seat (with memory settings), simulated leather seating surfaces, self-dimming rearview mirror, garage door opener, and sunshades for the second and third seating rows.

Safety and driver assistance features include rain-sensing wipers, forward-collision warning with automatic emergency braking, blind-spot monitoring with rear cross-traffic alert, lane-departure warning, adaptive cruise control with stop/go, 360-degree camera system, front/rear parking sensors with automatic stop, self-parking feature for parallel and perpendicular spaces, and automatic high beams.

A 10.1-inch touchscreen controls the infotainment system, which includes wireless Apple CarPlay/Android Auto smartphone integration, Amazon Alexa compatibility, voice commands, and satellite radio.

Engine & Transmission

Making a muscular 260 horsepower in total, the 2023 Pacifica Hybrid has a 3.6-liter V6 (using regular 87-octane gasoline) and a pair of electric motors energized by a lithium-ion battery. An automatic transmission sends drive to the front wheels.

With a full tank and a full battery, the total range is approximately 488 miles.

The 2023 Pacifica Hybrid is estimated to achieve 82 MPGe in combined driving (a mix of 45 percent on the highway and 55 percent in the city). When running as a conventional hybrid, it averages around 30 mpg.

The Grand Caravan platform is one of the most proven in the minivan segment, and the 3.6L Pentastar V6 is widely regarded as one of Chrysler's most durable engines. For buyers in Wayne County shopping on a realistic budget, this is the kind of vehicle that delivers immediate usability without the new-car depreciation hit.

Paired with a smooth 6-speed automatic transmission and front-wheel drive, this powertrain is well-suited to Michigan roads — whether you're navigating surface streets in Taylor, merging onto I-75, or heading out toward the outer Wayne County suburbs.

The flex fuel capability means this van can run on E85 ethanol or regular gasoline, giving you fuel flexibility when prices fluctuate. The 6-speed automatic shifts smoothly and holds up well over high mileage when fluid services are kept current. Real-world fuel economy typically falls in the 17-25 MPG range depending on driving conditions.Dodge Grand Caravan GT Features and Interior The GT is the sportier expression of the Grand Caravan lineup, distinguishing itself from base SE and SXT trims with blacked-out exterior badging, sport-tuned suspension, and upgraded interior appointments. Inside, buyers typically get heated front seats, a leather-wrapped steering wheel, and an upgraded Uconnect infotainment system with touchscreen and Bluetooth audio connectivity.

Seating for seven is standard, and the Grand Caravan's signature Stow 'n Go second and third-row seating folds completely flat into the floor — one of the most practical cargo solutions in any family vehicle. Whether you're hauling gear for a weekend trip up to Lake Erie or loading up after a Costco run, the Grand Caravan GT handles it without complaint.Dodge Grand Caravan Reliability and Ownership The Grand Caravan has logged millions of miles on American roads, and its reliability reputation — while not luxury-brand perfect — is solidly practical. The 3.6L Pentastar V6 is known to run well past 150,000 miles with regular oil changes and coolant flushes. Common ownership considerations at this mileage include inspecting the transmission fluid condition, checking the sliding door actuators (a known wear item), and verifying the HVAC blower motor.

Overall, Grand Caravan owners report high satisfaction with the van's day-to-day usability, low cost of ownership compared to competing minivans, and the wide availability of affordable parts. It's a pragmatic choice that has earned loyalty across the Midwest for good reason.Why Buy From Turbo Motors? Versatile, efficient, and practical, this 2018 Ford Transit Connect Passenger XL combines flexible passenger seating, convenient dual sliding doors, and excellent cargo versatility in a compact, easy-to-drive van. Key Features
? 2.5L 4-Cylinder Engine

? 6-Speed Automatic Transmission

? Rearview Camera
? Cruise Control
? Remote Keyless Entry
? Power Windows & Door Locks

Performance & Capability
Engine: 2.5L Inline-4
Horsepower: 169 HP
Torque: 171 lb-ft
Transmission: 6-Speed Automatic
Drivetrain: Front-Wheel Drive
Maximum Towing Capacity: Up to 2,000 lbs when properly equipped
Fuel Economy: Approx. 19 City / 27 Highway MPG

Specifications
Body Style: Passenger Van 4D
Trim: XL
Seating Capacity: Up to 7 Passengers
Fuel Type: Regular Unleaded Gasoline
Cargo Capacity: Up to approximately 106 cu ft with rear seats folded

The 2018 Ford Transit Connect Passenger XL combines passenger capacity, practical cargo space, and efficient performance in a compact van. With its dual sliding doors, flexible seating configuration, and dependable Ford engineering, it's an excellent choice for families, shuttle services, businesses, rideshare transportation, and everyday passenger use.
